body.statement: For the Kneser graph on the \(M\)-subsets of an \(n\)-set, where adjacency means disjointness and \(n\ge2M\), the unnormalized adjacency eigenvalue on \(\mathcal H_{n,k}\) is \((-1)^k\binom{n-M-k}{M-k}\), for \(0\le k\le M\).

source.verbatim_statement: Proposition 3.1. (Lovasz [23]) The eigenvalues of the Kneser graph are \(P_{id}=(-1)^i\binom{n-d-i}{d-i}=(-1)^i\binom{n-d-i}{n-2d}\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from the arXiv PDF of Brouwer, Cioaba, Ihringer, and McGinnis (2018), Proposition 3.1, page 10; accents in author names are omitted in this plain source carrier.
